definition.name: Focused Java private HTTP with authenticated historical native products

steps.name: Fetch only the exact historical compiled source commits
Check source, product selection and unchanged provider gates
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_java_private_http_replay tools.tests.test_java_private_http -v

steps.name: Retrieve only the fixed e97 host and four original03a helper binaries
Install the same pinned Java compiler tools without any native Cargo build
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --max-time 180 \
  https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-9.1.0-bin.zip \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip"
echo "a17ddd85a26b6a7f5ddb71ff8b05fc5104c0202c6e64782429790c933686c806  $RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" | sha256sum --check
unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-9.1.0/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
echo "87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171  $RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Acquire one pinned compiler cache and execute two fresh captured HTTP components
Retain bounded source-specific replay evidence without credentials or keys

with.name: java-private-http-replay-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-prepared/retrieval.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-prepared/host/host-retrieval.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-compiler/compiler-cache-selection.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/variant-*/build/source-inputs.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/variant-*/build/recipe-inputs.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/variant-*/build/compiler-inputs.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/variant-*/build/java-classpath.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/variant-*/build/http-client-profile.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/variant-*/build/BUILD-*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/variant-*/build/build-observation.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/variant-*/node/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/variant-*/node/physical-after.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-private-http-replay/variant-*/node/standard-invocations.json
